name: cellA_m31
about: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on 4 MI355X: TP4, ONE DP rank, fp8 KV, block 128, max len 1048576, prefix caching, DSpark 7 drafts at acceptance 3.13 (#752; ~/agent_scratch/752/m31/env_m31.sh). Capture rungs are ATOM's default up to max-num-seqs 128. One DP rank: graph_padding and row_padding are collinear inside a rung (identical at rungs 1-8), which no design separates (#739 2.4 rule 6): both kept, the check reported failed, the rungs judged by G. The deployment is the step-A smoke record's (pit2-p03-g08 /var/tmp/perzhang_compass/p752/m31/smoke_c8, memory readings 06105bf48e92; `gen_v1.py --record` on it gives the same fields): kv_tokens 56860 blocks x 128 (num_kvcache_blocks of its run.json), the prefill chunk ATOM's default 16384 (its serve line sets none), and no prefill token-graph buckets (M3.1 captures none), so the prefill vector takes no padding. Dry run: waits for a law fitted on the smoke record.
